changeSet.author: bookingroom
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM notification n WHERE n.type IN ( 'BOOKING_APPROVED', 'BOOKING_REJECTED', 'BOOKING_CANCELLED', 'BOOKING_EXPIRED', 'DEPT_CHANGE_APPROVED', 'DEPT_CHANGE_REJECTED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user_authority ua WHERE ua.user_id = n.user_id AND ua.authority_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN' );
